weapons.name: Terra Blade
weapons.source: Crafted from True Excalibur and True Night's Edge
weapons.why: It remains the best all-around projectile sword for the phase and still handles both Jungle Temple prep and general bossing cleanly.

weapons.name: Vampire Knives
weapons.source: Found in the Crimson biome chest of the Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: The lifesteal keeps melee surprisingly stable in messy post-Plantera farming and event encounters.

weapons.name: Seedler
weapons.why: This is a strong immediate Plantera reward and another reliable projectile-heavy sword option for the phase.

weapons.name: Paladin's Hammer
weapons.source: Dropped by Paladins in the Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: It gives melee a high-damage thrown option that fits well if you still like flail-like or returning weapon patterns.

armor.name: Turtle Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Turtle Shells and Chlorophyte Bars
armor.why: This is the safest conventional pre-Golem melee set because the research around Beetle timing is still a little contested.

armor.name: Chlorophyte Armor
armor.why: If you prefer a more generalist route, Chlorophyte still performs well through this entire phase.

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: It is still the easiest best-in-slot melee accessory to justify because it rolls several offensive benefits into one slot.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.why: Post-Plantera enemies and events apply enough debuffs that this becomes even more comfortable than before.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: The broad stat bonus is valuable for any melee build that has already stabilized its core survival tools.

accessories.name: Steampunk or Hoverboard Wings
accessories.source: Obtained from strong post-Plantera mobility routes
accessories.why: Flight is still mandatory when your farming loop now includes the Hardmode Dungeon, events, and Temple approach.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.why: The defense shred is still the most efficient weapon imbue you can carry into hard targets.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: It remains the universal baseline buff because every new event or Temple pull can hit hard.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.why: A direct damage increase helps speed up event waves and cut down awkward boss phases.

weapons.name: Chain Gun
weapons.source: Dropped by Santa-NK1 during Frost Moon
weapons.why: The research repeatedly treats this as the top pre-Golem gun if you can clear the event for it.

weapons.name: Megashark
weapons.source: Crafted from the Minishark, Illegal Gun Parts, Souls of Might, and Shark Fins
weapons.why: It stays relevant for players who have not gone deep on Frost Moon or event-specific farming yet.

weapons.name: Stake Launcher
weapons.source: Dropped by Vampires during Solar Eclipse
weapons.why: Its high per-shot damage gives ranger another strong event-farm payoff before Golem.

weapons.name: Tactical Shotgun
weapons.source: Dropped by Skeleton Commandos in the Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: It is the best broadly available non-event shotgun and works nicely if you want a close-range ranger route.

armor.name: Shroomite Armor
armor.why: This is the consensus best ranger set in the phase because its helmet specialization and stealth utility are both real upgrades.

armor.name: Chlorophyte Armor
armor.why: It remains a respectable fallback if your glowing mushroom setup or bar conversion route is not ready.

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: It is still the cleanest premium ranger accessory because the crit and aim support both stay relevant.

accessories.name: Ranger Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: The direct damage bonus remains easy to slot into nearly every build in the phase.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: A broad stat increase is especially nice once your weapon choices are already very strong.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.why: Debuff immunity is valuable in the post-Plantera farming loop where random hits can stack ugly statuses fast.

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.why: It stays the best simple class buff for ranger, especially if your setup still leans on bows anywhere in the phase.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.why: Ammo savings matter more once rapid-fire endgame-adjacent weapons enter the picture.

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.why: This is free ranged value before every major encounter and stacks with the potion nicely.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Even ranger benefits from a sturdier baseline once events and Temple pulls get chaotic.

weapons.name: Razorblade Typhoon
weapons.why: This is the consensus top mage weapon of the phase because the homing blades stay oppressive in almost every encounter.

weapons.name: Shadowbeam Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Necromancers in the Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: The bouncing beam pattern is excellent in tighter rooms and event funnels.

weapons.name: Inferno Fork
weapons.source: Dropped by Diabolists in the Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: It gives mage another high-impact projectile option with strong area denial for clustered targets.

weapons.name: Magnet Sphere
weapons.why: It remains a useful carry-over because it keeps dealing damage while you reposition.

armor.name: Spectre Armor
armor.why: The damage-focused Spectre route is the default bossing answer here and the strongest overall mage upgrade before Golem.

armor.name: Spectre Hood Loadout
armor.why: Swapping to the hood is still worthwhile when you want the lifesteal safety valve for messy content.

accessories.name: Celestial Emblem
accessories.why: It is still the cleanest premium mage accessory because it boosts damage while supporting mana flow.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: Mage appreciates the broad stat lift once the core mana accessories are already in place.

accessories.name: Mana Flower
accessories.why: Auto-potions continue to remove a lot of execution friction during the phase's longer fights.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.why: Debuff immunity remains a big comfort upgrade when so much of the content now involves status-heavy enemies.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.why: It stays the best direct mage buff because the phase rewards squeezing extra value out of already-strong weapons.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: Sustain matters more than ever once the premium mage tools start draining mana aggressively.

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: It is still free magic power before every serious attempt, so it belongs in the routine.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: The extra forgiveness is welcome because post-Plantera content can punish mage instantly when positioning slips.

weapons.name: Xeno Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Saucer during Martian Madness
weapons.why: This is the consensus best summoner minion for the phase because the UFOs stay accurate and aggressive.

weapons.name: Tempest Staff
weapons.why: It offers another strong late-phase minion option if you have already gone through Fishron farming.

weapons.name: Dark Harvest
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking during Pumpkin Moon
weapons.why: This is one of the best accessible late summoner whips and a major reason to farm Pumpkin Moon before Golem.

weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.source: Earned from Old One's Army Tier 2 or 3 progression
weapons.why: If you invest in Old One's Army, this gives summoner another excellent whip route with strong direct control.

armor.name: Tiki Armor
armor.source: Bought from the Witch Doctor after Plantera
armor.why: This is the standard best pre-Golem summoner set because the extra minion capacity is too valuable to ignore.

armor.name: Spooky Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Spooky Wood from Pumpkin Moon
armor.why: If you are farming the event anyway, this is a strong damage-focused alternative to Tiki.

armor.name: Spider Armor
armor.why: It remains the reasonable fallback if your post-Plantera summon progression is still catching up.

accessories.name: Papyrus Scarab
accessories.why: This is the standout summoner accessory because it adds both slot value and direct minion scaling.

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.why: An extra minion remains one of the cleanest pure-value upgrades available to summoner.

accessories.name: Necromantic Scroll
accessories.source: Dropped by Mourning Wood during Pumpkin Moon
accessories.why: It is both a real summon upgrade and the natural step toward the Papyrus Scarab.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.why: Debuff immunity gives summoner a lot of breathing room in the phase's messier event content.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.why: An extra minion is still the best single buff you can bring into a summoner build.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: It stacks cleanly with the potion and remains part of every real summoner pre-fight routine.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Summoner still needs all the baseline survivability help it can get.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: The damage reduction is especially welcome when a summoner gets clipped by dense event patterns.
